tasks.composition: Horizontal pair, 2400x900, 25 fps, 10 s. Matching external camera and appearance; separate autonomous rollout excerpts at 1x. No whole-task success claim.

scale.composition: 20 columns x 10 rows, flatten top 5 rows and fold bottom 5; 12 s starting at source time 0. Camera crop pulls back to full collection. Source sampled at 10 Hz, encoded at 25 fps, 1x time. Recorded clips, not concurrent simulation.

robots.composition: 5 columns x 2 rows, flatten top/fold bottom, 2400x720, 25 fps, 10 s, 1x. Individual paired files robot-{robot}.mp4 are 1280x480.
robots.scope: PIPER recorded motion; other robots retargeted kinematic references. Shared visual_layout, camera matched per robot across tasks. Not closed-loop policy validation.

asset_pool.scope: Existing geometry/material preview; not 500 parallel simulations.

excluded_from_home.reason: High camera clips lifted cloth; source marks training_eligible=false. Preserve for technical inspection, not main evidence.
Camera/material changes distract from the primary story. Preserve supporting source.
Replaced by 200 distinct trajectories; retained as secondary no-script fallback.
